summary.text: Meloyde Blancett is a Democratic member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 78 since 2016 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Meloyde Blancett took office on November 23, 2016.
Ballotpedia lists her 2025-2026 committee assignments as the Appropriations and Budget Committee and the Commerce & Economic Development Oversight Committee.
Tony Oliva, an independent, is her opponent in the November 3, 2026 general election.
